J0Z0KF export-string checkpoint ports original XclExpString value construction/assignment/append, actual SAL byte conversion, UTF16 and byte limits, sticky Unicode/LF flags, formatting-run limits/deduplication, hashes/comparisons and memory header/buffer output. XclXmlUtils accepts the actual value and delegates to its Unicode vector, including original empty-vector behavior in byte mode. Actual ZIP/XML text emission is tested. Native record-stream Write/PrepareWrite and their NoHeader state, full XclExpXmlStream/root/font-rich output, diagnostics/invalid pointer domains and full XLSX workbook/UI acceptance remain unported or unqualified; no fake stream/font/global provider is supplied. CALC682 records original mixed-mode ordering assumptions. Existing Uint8Array UTF8 transport remains explicit; JS owns physical vectors.
J0Z0KF font-data/export checkpoint ports actual XclFontData default/copy/reset, original scalar/native/API conversions, equality excluding style, charset/weight owners and complete consumed WriteFontData XML ordering. Source Windows/VCL API-family mismatch and retained complex-color state after Clear remain unchanged (CALC683/CALC684). Theme permutation and last-LumMod/LumOff tint conversion use genuine ComplexColor. OString number(double) uses the new original byte C facade over the existing actual formatter/SAL byte owners. Native VCL/SVX font extraction constructors, XclExpFont/FontBuffer/root integration and complete rich-string/workbook/filter/UI output remain unported; no replacement font/root provider is supplied.
J0Z0KF font extraction checkpoint implements both original VCL/SVX XclFontData constructors and FillFromVclFont/FillFromSvxFont over actual existing Font/SvxFont and ComplexColor owners. Source VCL Clear-before-fill and direct SVX construction, explicit erased base-reference selection, stored const font getters, style clearing, upper-capped twip height, complete complex-color copying and SVX escapement are preserved. XclTools::GetXclFontName uses actual GetSubsFontName ONLYONE|MS with original full-list fallback and owned return values. No placeholder font/locale/configuration provider or DTO is introduced. Genuine XclExpFont/FontBuffer/root and complete rich-string/workbook/filter/UI integration remain unfinished; underlying VCL rendering/ABI domains retain their existing unqualified boundaries.
